title: The Summit of the Sepik Basin
author: Sable Pemberton
blurb: Beatrix Underhill, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must cross the range ahead of the snows, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
